text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's summer! The ocean!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's the Kikuka Sho~~!

Days were spent running with even greater 
vigor toward victory in the Kikuka Sho. 
Then, one day—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: My heartfelt thanks to you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
!? What's the matter all of a sudden, 
Chairwoman?!

Chairwoman Akikawa came to visit 
Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! In fact, ever since the Japan 
Derby, applications for the next open 
campus have seen a slight increase to 1.3 
times the usual number!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The reasons are, of course, countless! 
Among them, I am certain that your great 
performance is one major reason!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
In fact, quite a few application surveys 
mentioned being inspired by your positive 
attitude at the Japan Derby!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no...! It's totally a coincidence! 
There's no way I'd do that!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, I've been kind of wondering... 
Why did you choose me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'm happy! I'm so, so happy, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If you want someone to guide the 
Umamusume, what about Bourbon-san or 
Rice-san?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but think... there are 
probably way stronger girls who are much 
better suited for this...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. And here I thought you'd 
realize it as you ran the races!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
You are still ignorant of your own 
potential!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Pyeh!?

Chairwoman Akikawa cleared her throat 
loudly, then turned back to 
Matikanetannhauser with a formal demeanor.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It's not your race record that attracts 
me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, at first glance you're just 
an ordinary Umamusume! Yet that is 
precisely what makes you one of a kind!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Being completely ordinary makes one 
unique...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Do you not remember?! The sight of your 
classmate looking forward, spurred on by 
just one word from you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I really need to start taking a leaf 
out of your book.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely because it was you that I 
could give that push!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
More than anyone else, I want you to 
believe in that first!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Eh, ah, well, um! If you ask if I have an 
idea, it's not like I don't, but...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, whether I was really able to give 
her a push is debatable— so, well, but... 
I see...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I might be able to give someone a push 
forward, huh...
The day after that happened.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since the Chairwoman told me that, 
I've been feeling all fidgety~!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, isn't there any kind of training 
that can help me shake off these 
jitters~!?"
choice_data_list:
Then let's swim around the island and get 
buff!

In that case, focus your mind with a 
marathon to your limits.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Understood~! I'm off!

And so, Matikanetannhauser dove into the 
ocean and disappeared into the distance in 
the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Focusing my mind! I'm going to give it my 
all!

And so, Matikane Tannhauser sprinted 
across the sandy beach and vanished into 
the distance.

It was rare for her, usually so 
unflappable, to get so flustered.

Chairwoman Akikawa's expectations may have 
stirred something, just a little, within 
Matikanetannhauser.
